name: core.openwop.workflows.campaign-ops
description: Agency campaign operations (ADR 0923): turn an operator's change request into a hashed change set of constrained edits on a client's landing page and email draft, for approval.

chains.label: Campaign change request
chains.description: Interprets one change request for one client and proposes the edits. If facts are missing (which Thursday, which link) it asks and stops; once answered it runs again. Otherwise it reads each asset's editable fields and proposes the smallest edits that carry out the request, as a change set waiting for approval. Nothing is written to a page or an email here.

orgId.description: The client organization the request belongs to.

requestId.description: The change request to work on.

version.description: The request version to work on. An edited request has a newer version, and the older one is no longer worked on.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's model-calling nodes (for example anthropic, openai, google). Fixed into those nodes when the workflow is created. Leave unset to keep the nodes' own default.

model.description: Model id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Must be offered by `provider` in the host catalog. Set it together with `provider`.

chains.label: Carry out an approved campaign change
chains.description: Writes an approved change set to its client's page and email draft, one destination at a time, and checks each one by reading it back. Started only by the approval of that exact change set; a copy cannot carry out anything.

orgId.description: The client organization the change belongs to.

approvalId.description: The approval of the change set to carry out.
